description: This is the source code for the class ArrayVariable, which models a dynamic array of BaseVariable objects in a code generation framework for Java or C. It provides methods for resolving references, generating code for encoding/decoding JSON, and other utility functions related to array handling in generated code.

classes.name: ArrayVariable
classes.description: Models a dynamic array of BaseVariable elements, providing methods for type resolution, code generation for serialization/deserialization in Java and C, and other utility functions tailored for code generation tasks.

methods.name: ArrayVariable(ICArrayVariable bean)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes ArrayVariable with provided ICArrayVariable bean.

methods.name: getFirstElement
methods.description: Returns the element type of the array.

methods.name: resolveReferences
methods.description: Resolves the element type reference based on the bean configuration.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Indicates that this variable is an array.

methods.name: isPtr
methods.description: Indicates that this variable is a pointer type, always true for ArrayVariable.

methods.name: getJavaBaseType
methods.description: Returns the Java base type of the array elements, e.g., Integer for int types.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java type representing the array, which is an ArrayList of the base type.

methods.name: getJavaConstructorLines
methods.description: Generates Java code lines for constructing and initializing the array.

methods.name: getCtype
methods.description: Returns the C language type for the array, which is 'icLinkedList'.

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Returns the JSON key for this array variable, which is its name.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to encode the array into JSON format.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to decode the array from JSON format.

methods.name: getJavaEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code lines to encode the array into a JSON array.

methods.name: getJavaDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code lines to decode the array from a JSON array.

methods.name: getJavaIpcObjectType
methods.description: Returns null as ArrayVariable is not supported as IPC object type.
